# Foundation & Crawlspace Directory (foundationcrawlspace.online)

> Independent California contractor directory and homeowner cost guide for foundation repair, house leveling, crawlspace encapsulation, vapor barriers, and French drain waterproofing across 11 Greater Sacramento, Placer County, and El Dorado County cities (91 public contractor profiles).

## Buying & Cost Guides (PAA + PASF Answers)
- [Foundation Repair Greater Sacramento: Methods & Cost Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/foundation-repair/): How to tell if your Sacramento, Roseville, or Folsom foundation needs piers, helical vs. push pier costs, insurance rules, and how to vet CSLB contractors.
- [House Leveling Sacramento: Slab & Pier-and-Beam Cost Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/house-leveling/): What house leveling costs in Sacramento, Folsom, and Auburn, pier-and-beam shimming vs. slab foam lifting, pipe protection during lifts, and vetting quotes.
- [Crawlspace Encapsulation Sacramento: Moisture Barriers & 2026 Costs](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/crawlspace-encapsulation/): Crawlspace encapsulation costs in Sacramento, Folsom, and Auburn, 20-mil vapor barriers vs. basic plastic, downsides, tax credit rules, and local pros.
- [French Drain Installation Sacramento: Yard Drainage Costs & Pros](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/drainage-french-drains/): What French drain installation costs in Sacramento, Roseville, and El Dorado Hills (100 ft, 200 ft & 300 ft runs), downsides, and CSLB-vetted drainage contractors.
- [Helical Piers vs. Push Piers: Cost, Soil & Best Fit in Sacramento](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/helical-piers-vs-push-piers/): Compare helical piers vs. push piers in Sacramento, Roseville, and Folsom: cost per pier, expansive clay depth, installation steps, and warranties.
- [Bowing Basement Wall Repair: Carbon Fiber vs. Wall Anchors & Cost](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/bowing-basement-wall-repair/): Fix bowing basement and retaining walls in Sacramento & Placer County: carbon fiber straps vs. steel wall anchors, deflection limits, and repair prices.
- [Foundation Crack Repair Guide: Horizontal vs. Vertical Cracks & Costs](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/foundation-crack-repair/): Which foundation cracks are normal vs. structural, epoxy vs. polyurethane injection, DIY caulk traps, and Sacramento crack repair costs.
- [Mudjacking vs. Foam Jacking: Concrete Slab Leveling Cost & Lifespan](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/mudjacking-vs-polyurethane-foam-jacking/): Compare mudjacking vs. polyurethane foam lifting (polyjacking) in Sacramento: hole sizes, cure times, weight on weak clay, prices, and lifespan.
- [Pier and Beam Foundation Repair: Crawl Space Jacks & Cost](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/pier-and-beam-foundation-repair/): How contractors fix sloping or bouncy raised floors in older Sacramento, Auburn, and Placerville homes: crawl space jacks, shimming, and costs.
- [Structural Engineer vs. Foundation Contractor: Who to Hire First](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/structural-engineer-vs-foundation-repair-contractor/): When to pay $500-$1,200+ for an independent California PE structural engineer vs. calling a foundation contractor first in Greater Sacramento.
- [Crawl Space Vapor Barrier vs. Encapsulation: Sacramento Cost Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/vapor-barrier-vs-crawl-space-encapsulation/): 6-mil vs. 12-mil vs. 20-mil crawlspace vapor barriers vs. full sealed encapsulation in Sacramento's climate: costs, when simple liners suffice, and contractor tips.
- [Crawl Space Dry Rot Repair: Floor Joist & Sill Plate Replacement](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/crawl-space-dry-rot-joist-repair/): Repairing crawlspace dry rot, spongy bathroom floors, rotted floor joists, and sill plates in Sacramento, Auburn & Placerville homes without tearing up floors.
- [Standing Water in Crawl Space? Sump Pumps & Drains (Sacramento)](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/standing-water-in-crawl-space-solutions/): Stop seasonal crawlspace flooding in Sacramento, Folsom, Granite Bay, and El Dorado Hills: interior footer drains, sump pumps with battery backups, and costs.
- [French Drain vs. Catch Basin: Which Fixes Yard Flooding Better?](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/french-drain-vs-catch-basin-surface-drain/): Compare subsurface French drains vs. catch basin surface drains for soggy Sacramento lawns, patio puddles, clay yards, and El Dorado Hills hillsides.
- [Underground Downspout Drainage: Stop Foundation Runoff Damage](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/downspout-drainage-foundation-protection/): Replace failing plastic splash blocks with smooth Schedule 40/SDR-35 underground downspout pipes, pop-up emitters, cleanouts, and Sacramento costs.
- [Yard Grading & Drainage Swales: Fixing Negative Slope in Sacramento](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/yard-grading-swale-drainage-contractor/): Fix negative soil slope pooling water against Roseville, Lincoln, Folsom, and El Dorado homes: 6-inch code slope rules, laser re-grading, swales, and costs.
- [Post-Tension Slab Repair Roseville, Folsom & Sacramento: Cables & Cost](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/post-tension-slab-foundation-repair/): Post-tension concrete slab cracks, snapped cable signs, GPR cable scanning, and repair costs for 1990s to 2020s homes in Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom, Lincoln & Elk Grove.
- [Retaining Wall Repair El Dorado Hills, Granite Bay & Placer County](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/retaining-wall-repair-stabilization/): Fix leaning, bulging, or cracked concrete and CMU retaining walls in El Dorado Hills, Granite Bay, Folsom & Auburn using helical tiebacks and wall drains.
- [Concrete Driveway, Sidewalk & Pool Deck Leveling Sacramento](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/services/concrete-driveway-patio-pool-deck-leveling/): Lift sunken concrete driveways, garage lips, pool decks & HOA sidewalk trip hazards in Sacramento using polyurethane foam jacking (save 50-70% vs replacement).

## Key Local Cost & Repair Facts
- **Foundation Pier Underpinning Cost (Sacramento)**: $1,600 to $3,000 per push pier or helical pier; most residential structural projects run $6,500 to $22,000.
- **Pier-and-Beam House Leveling Cost**: $2,500 to $6,500 for accessible crawlspace re-shimming and adjustable steel posts; full deep-pier slab lifting runs $8,000 to $25,000+.
- **Polyurethane Foam Slab Lifting**: $1,500 to $4,500 for settled interior slab pockets, driveways, or garages.
- **Homeowners Insurance Rule**: Standard California policies exclude clay-soil movement; coverage applies only when a sudden plumbing break under the slab washes out support soil.

## County Contractor Directories
- [Sacramento County, CA Directory & Soil Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/directory/california/sacramento-county/): Alluvial valley basin clay and river silt along the American and Sacramento river corridors cause seasonal expansion and contraction beneath both older 1950s to 1980s raised-floor subfloors and newer slab subdivisions.
- [Placer County, CA Directory & Soil Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/directory/california/placer-county/): Expansive West Roseville and Lincoln basin clays meet shallow hardpan and granite shelves around Rocklin, Granite Bay, and Auburn foothills, creating mixed slab edge heave and subsurface winter spring seepage.
- [El Dorado County, CA Directory & Soil Guide](https://foundationcrawlspace.online/directory/california/el-dorado-county/): Steep decomposed granite slopes, fractured bedrock, and shallow clay pockets across El Dorado Hills, Cameron Park, and Placerville push fast winter sheet runoff straight against lower retaining walls and crawlspace stem walls.
